image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, positioned on dry ground covered in straw and twigs. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible scute seams and some mud residue. Its head is extended, showing a greyish-brown textured neck and a distinct eye with a yellow iris. One front limb is visible, appearing webbed with dark scales. The plastron edge is slightly visible, appearing yellowish.

The tail is completely occluded by the rear of the carapace and the ground/straw.
